result:
Both specialists independently found the same 8 defects. I traced each one by hand against the code. Neither specialist could run code, because they had no shell, so none of this was confirmed by execution.

| Line | Defect | Hand-traced failing case |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | `counts = {}` is a class attribute, so every `Counter` shares one dict. | `a.add("x")` also shows up in `b.counts`. |
| 11 | `datetime.now()` is evaluated once, when the function is defined. | Every `stamp(e)` call without `when` gets the import-time timestamp. |
| 17 | The lambdas look up `i` when called, so all three see `i == 2`. | `[f(5) for f in make_multipliers()]` gives `[10, 10, 10]`, not `[0, 5, 10]`. |
| 21 | `re.match` has no end anchor, and `\d` also matches non-ASCII digits. | `"ABC12345"` and `"ABC1234\n"` return `True`. |
| 30 | `while lo < hi` exits before checking the last remaining candidate. | `find([5], 5)` returns -1. `find([1,2,3], 3)` also returns -1. |
| 42 | The loop removes items from the list while iterating over it, so the item after each removal is skipped. | `[-1,-2,3]` becomes `[-2,3]`. |
| 52 | Prices go through binary floats and `int()` truncates them. | `["0.29"]` gives 28, because `0.29*100 == 28.999999999999996`. `["0.58"]` gives 57. |
| 60 | The copy is shallow, so the rows are shared with `grid`. | Setting `c[0][0] = 9` changes `grid[0][0]`. |

- **Count:** The debugger's summary said 7 bugs but its table listed 8. I count 8 distinct ones, with the two problems on line 21 merged into a single bug.
- **Judged correct by both:** `clamp`, `chunks_of` for positive `n`, `same_object` and `first_word`.
